html:
The Kingdom of Tahiti was founded by the chief Pōmare I, who used European muskets and allies, among them men from the Bounty, to dominate Tahiti from the late 1780s.

His son Pōmare II converted to Christianity with the London Missionary Society and won the battle of Te Feipī in 1815, after which the old gods were abandoned. In 1819 he issued a written law code drafted with missionary help.

Queen Pōmare IV reigned for fifty years but could not keep France out: a protectorate was forced on her in 1842, leading to the Franco-Tahitian War. Her son Pōmare V gave up the kingdom in 1880, when France annexed it. The navigator Tupaia came from this world.
